name: ui-detail-panel
description: DetailPanel — UI factory (1:1 with the @almadar/ui detail-panel pattern).

schema.description: DetailPanel — UI factory (1:1 with the @almadar/ui detail-panel pattern).
schema.name: ui-detail-panel

actions.description: Unified actions array - first action with variant='primary' is the main action
actions.label: Actions

activity.description: Activity entries shown under the record (workflow).
activity.label: Activity

activityContent.description: Activity composed in instead of `activity` — e.g. the record's own history trait (workflow).
activityContent.label: Activity Content

ariaBusy.description: This region is updating; assistive technology waits before announcing it.
ariaBusy.label: Aria-busy

ariaCurrent.description: Marks the current item in a set: the current page, step, location, date or time.
ariaCurrent.label: Aria-current

ariaDescribedby.description: Id of the element whose text describes this one (help text, error).
ariaDescribedby.label: Aria-describedby

ariaExpanded.description: Whether the element it controls is expanded.
ariaExpanded.label: Aria-expanded

ariaHidden.description: Hide from assistive technology (decorative content only).
ariaHidden.label: Aria-hidden

ariaLabel.description: Accessible name read by screen readers when the visible text is missing or not descriptive (e.g. an icon-only control).
ariaLabel.label: Aria-label

ariaLabelledby.description: Id of the element whose text names this one.
ariaLabelledby.label: Aria-labelledby

ariaLive.description: Announce changes to this region: polite waits for a pause, assertive interrupts.
ariaLive.label: Aria-live

ariaSelected.description: Whether this item is selected (tabs, options, grid cells).
ariaSelected.label: Aria-selected

avatarField.description: Record field holding the avatar image. The profile look always shows an avatar, with the title's initials when this is unset or empty.
avatarField.label: Avatar Field

backAction.description: Navigation-back affordance. Renders top-LEFT before the title (OS/back convention — Almadar_UX §8.4), spatially separated from the right-aligned action buttons + close X. Never inferred from actions[] labels.
backAction.label: Back Action

closeEvent.description: The event of the declared action that dismisses the panel. The matching action renders as the header close ×; omitted, no × is drawn.
closeEvent.label: Close Event

coverField.description: Record field holding the cover image (profile).
coverField.label: Cover Field

dir.description: Text direction of this element's content.
dir.label: Dir

enter.description: How this element animates in when it mounts (theme-styled); overrides the theme's default slot entry. `none` opts out.
enter.label: Enter

enterDelay.description: Stagger step for the entry: waits this many `--motion-enter-stagger` steps before animating.
enterDelay.label: Enter Delay

fields.description: Fields to display: field names, or declared fields ({ name, label, variant, format, colorMap, labels })
fields.label: Fields

lang.description: Language of this element's content (BCP 47, e.g. ar, sl, en).
lang.label: Lang

lineItemsContent.description: Line items composed in instead of `lineItems` — e.g. the child rows' own trait (ledger).
lineItemsContent.label: Line Items Content

look.description: Page variant: panel (labelled fields, default), profile (person/member hero), showcase (image-first product/listing), workflow (lifecycle stepper + activity), map (location hero), ledger (document with line items + totals), conversation (thread beside the record), workspace (tabbed record).
look.label: Look

maxInlineActions.description: Max inline action buttons before the rest collapse into a '⋯' overflow menu (mirrors DataGrid's maxInlineActions). Defaults to 2 — primary + secondary visible, the rest under the menu — so every detail panel carries the same action pattern.
maxInlineActions.label: Max Inline Actions

mediaField.description: Record field holding the image, or list of images, the showcase look leads with.
mediaField.label: Media Field

onTitleCommit.description: When bound, the title becomes editable in place: clicking it swaps the heading for an input, Enter or blur commits, Escape reverts. Receives the committed title and the record's id so the host can persist a partial update. Unbound, the title stays a plain heading.
onTitleCommit.label: On Title Commit

relationsData.description: Relation display data: { fieldName: [{value, label}] } — injected server-side by the runtime (relation-option injection) or bound by compiled codegen; resolves stored foreign ids to display names.
relationsData.label: Relations Data

role.description: WAI-ARIA role when the element's native semantics don't describe it.
role.label: Role

selfFetch.description: true (default) = a mount that carries an id loads that one row (never the collection); a create-mode mount skips the load. false = a composing atom owns the load.
selfFetch.label: Fetch its own row on mount?

showActions.description: When false, hides the action buttons + overflow menu (and the close ×). Defaults to true.
showActions.label: Show Actions

skeleton.description: Skeleton drawn while loading, and the shape an empty slot shows while this element's server render is in flight (`none` opts out).
skeleton.label: Skeleton

stageField.description: Record field holding the current lifecycle stage (workflow).
stageField.label: Stage Field

stages.description: The lifecycle in order, `{ value, label }` per stage (workflow).
stages.label: Stages

surface.description: Content surface: `auto` paints the theme's surface behind this block unless it already sits on one (a card, dialog or another block); `none` opts out. Inline mode only; the slide-over is itself a surface.
surface.label: Surface

tabIndex.description: 0 puts the element in the Tab order; -1 makes it focusable only programmatically.
tabIndex.label: Tab Index

tabs.description: Tabs after the overview tab, each listing declared field names (workspace).
tabs.label: Tabs

threadContent.description: The thread composed in instead of `thread` — e.g. the replies' own trait with its composer (conversation).
threadContent.label: Thread Content

totals.description: Record fields shown as the document's totals, in order (ledger).
totals.label: Totals

viewerRole.description: The viewer's role that each action's `roles` is checked against; bind it at the call site (e.g. `viewerRole: @user.role`). Empty = only actions with no `roles` show.
viewerRole.label: Viewer's role

emits.description: The event of the declared action that dismisses the panel. The matching action renders as the header close ×; omitted, no × is drawn.
DetailPanel row finished loading; payload.data holds the single row.

events.description: Mount payload; a host that routes to this panel by id (a :id page param) passes it here.
events.name: Initialize

events.description: DetailPanel row finished loading; payload.data holds the single row.
events.name: Detail panel loaded

events.description: The event of the declared action that dismisses the panel. The matching action renders as the header close ×; omitted, no × is drawn.
events.name: @config.close event

;; @pattern "detail-panel"
orbital DetailPanelOrbital {
    type DetailPanelLoaded = Event { data : DetailPanelItem } "DetailPanel row finished loading; payload.data holds the single row"
  type DetailPanelError = {
    message : string!
    name : string
    code : string
    stack : string
  }
  type DetailPanelStatus = {
    label : string!
    variant : "default" | "success" | "warning" | "danger" | "info"
  }
  type DetailPanelSectionsItem = {
    title : string!
    fields : [DetailPanelSectionsItemFieldsItem]!
  }
  type DetailPanelSectionsItemFieldsItem = {
    label : string!
    value : node!
    icon : icon
    copyable : boolean
  }
  type DetailPanelActionsItem = {
    label : string!
    icon : icon
    event : event
    navigatesTo : string
    variant : "primary" | "secondary" | "ghost" | "danger"
    when : SExpr
    payload : SExpr
    roles : [string]
  }
  type DetailPanelBackAction = {
    label : string!
    icon : icon
    event : event
    navigatesTo : string
    variant : "primary" | "secondary" | "ghost" | "danger"
    when : SExpr
    payload : SExpr
  }
  type DetailPanelFieldsItem = {
    name : string!
    label : string
    icon : icon
    variant : "h3" | "h4" | "overline" | "avatar" | "body" | "caption" | "badge" | "small" | "progress"
    format : "date" | "time" | "datetime" | "currency" | "number" | "boolean" | "percent"
    colorMap : Map string DetailPanelFieldsItemColorMapValue
    labels : Map string string
    type : string
    values : [string]
    relation : DetailPanelFieldsItemRelation
  }
  type DetailPanelFieldsItemColorMapValue = "default" | "primary" | "secondary" | "success" | "warning" | "danger" | "error" | "info" | "neutral" | "destructive"
  type DetailPanelFieldsItemRelation = {
    entity : string!
    cardinality : "one" | "many" | "one-to-many" | "many-to-one" | "many-to-many"
  }
  type DetailPanelRelationsDataValueItem = {
    value : string!
    label : string!
    description : string
    disabled : boolean
  }
  type DetailPanelStagesItem = {
    value : string!
    label : string!
  }
  type DetailPanelActivityItem = {
    id : string!
    title : string!
    description : string
    date : string
    status : "complete" | "active" | "pending" | "error"
    icon : icon
    tags : [string]
  }
  type DetailPanelLineItemColumnsItem = {
    key : string!
    field : string
    header : string
    label : string
    width : string
    align : "left" | "center" | "right"
    className : string
    weight : "normal" | "medium" | "semibold"
    format : "badge" | "date" | "currency" | "number" | "percent" | "boolean"
    colorMap : Map string DetailPanelLineItemColumnsItemColorMapValue
    labels : Map string string
    variant : "h3" | "h4"
    icon : icon
    sortable : boolean
  }
  type DetailPanelLineItemColumnsItemColorMapValue = "default" | "primary" | "secondary" | "success" | "warning" | "danger" | "error" | "info" | "neutral" | "destructive"
  type DetailPanelTotalsItem = {
    name : string!
    label : string
    icon : icon
    variant : "h3" | "h4" | "overline" | "avatar" | "body" | "caption" | "badge" | "small" | "progress"
    format : "date" | "time" | "datetime" | "currency" | "number" | "boolean" | "percent"
    colorMap : Map string DetailPanelTotalsItemColorMapValue
    labels : Map string string
  }
  type DetailPanelTotalsItemColorMapValue = "default" | "primary" | "secondary" | "success" | "warning" | "danger" | "error" | "info" | "neutral" | "destructive"
  type ReplyNodeRow = {
    authorName : string
    content : string
    authorAvatarUrl : string
    postedAt : string
    voteCount : number
    userVote : "up" | "down" | "none"
    collapsed : boolean
    replies : [ReplyNodeRow]
  }
  type DetailPanelTabsItem = {
    id : string!
    label : string!
    fields : [string]
    content : node

    authorName : string = "Author Name"
    content : string = "Content"
    authorAvatarUrl : string = "Author Avatar Url"
    postedAt : string = "Posted At"
    voteCount : number = 1
    userVote : "up" | "down" | "none" = up
    collapsed : boolean = false
    replies : [ReplyNodeRow] = []

    state resolving {

        @tier "presentation"

        @label "Max Inline Actions"

        @tier "presentation"
      fields : [DetailPanelFieldsItem] = [{ name: "Name", label: "Label", icon: "circle", variant: h3, format: date, type: "Type", values: ["Item", "Item 2"], relation: { entity: "Entity", cardinality: one } }, { name: "Name 2", label: "Label 2", icon: "circle", variant: h4, format: time, type: "Type 2", values: ["Item", "Item 2"], relation: { entity: "Entity 2", cardinality: many } }]
        @label "Fields"
        @description "Fields to display: field names, or declared fields ({ name, label, variant, format, colorMap, labels })"
        @tier "presentation"
      fieldNames : [string] = []
        @label "Field Names"
        @description "Alias for fields - backwards compatibility"
        @tier "presentation"
      mode : string
        @label "Mode"
        @description "Display mode (passed by compiler)"
        @tier "presentation"
      position : "left" | "right"
        @label "Position"
        @description "Panel position (for drawer/sidebar placement)"
        @tier "presentation"
      width : string
        @label "Width"
        @description "Panel width (CSS value, e.g., '400px', '50%')"
        @tier "presentation"
      displayFields : [string] = []
        @label "Display Fields"
        @description "Display fields (alias for fields)"
        @tier "presentation"
      showActions : boolean = true
        @label "Show Actions"
        @description "When false, hides the action buttons + overflow menu (and the close ×). Defaults to true."
        @tier "presentation"
      relationsData : Map string [DetailPanelRelationsDataValueItem] = {}
        @label "Relations Data"
        @description "Relation display data: { fieldName: [{value, label}] } — injected server-side by the runtime (relation-option injection) or bound by compiled codegen; resolves stored foreign ids to display names."
        @tier "presentation"
      look : "panel" | "profile" | "showcase" | "workflow" | "map" | "ledger" | "conversation" | "workspace" = panel
        @label "Look"
        @description "Page variant: panel (labelled fields, default), profile (person/member hero), showcase (image-first product/listing), workflow (lifecycle stepper + activity), map (location hero), ledger (document with line items + totals), conversation (thread beside the record), workspace (tabbed record)."
        @tier "presentation"
      avatarField : string
        @label "Avatar Field"
        @description "Record field holding the avatar image. The profile look always shows an avatar, with the title's initials when this is unset or empty."
        @tier "presentation"
      coverField : string
        @label "Cover Field"
        @description "Record field holding the cover image (profile)."
        @tier "presentation"
      mediaField : string
        @label "Media Field"
        @description "Record field holding the image, or list of images, the showcase look leads with."
        @tier "presentation"
      stageField : string
        @label "Stage Field"
        @description "Record field holding the current lifecycle stage (workflow)."
        @tier "presentation"
      stages : [DetailPanelStagesItem] = []
        @label "Stages"
        @description "The lifecycle in order, `{ value, label }` per stage (workflow)."
        @tier "presentation"
      activity : [DetailPanelActivityItem] = []
        @label "Activity"
        @description "Activity entries shown under the record (workflow)."
        @tier "presentation"
      activityContent : node
        @label "Activity Content"
        @description "Activity composed in instead of `activity` — e.g. the record's own history trait (workflow)."
        @tier "presentation"
      latitudeField : string
        @label "Latitude Field"
        @description "Record fields holding the location (map)."
        @tier "presentation"
      longitudeField : string
        @label "Longitude Field"
        @description "longitudeField prop"
        @tier "presentation"
      lineItemColumns : [DetailPanelLineItemColumnsItem] = []
        @label "Line Item Columns"
        @description "Columns of the line-items table (ledger)."
        @tier "presentation"
      lineItemsContent : node
        @label "Line Items Content"
        @description "Line items composed in instead of `lineItems` — e.g. the child rows' own trait (ledger)."
        @tier "presentation"
      totals : [DetailPanelTotalsItem] = []
        @label "Totals"
        @description "Record fields shown as the document's totals, in order (ledger)."
        @tier "presentation"
      threadContent : node
        @label "Thread Content"
        @description "The thread composed in instead of `thread` — e.g. the replies' own trait with its composer (conversation)."
        @tier "presentation"
      tabs : [DetailPanelTabsItem] = []
        @label "Tabs"
        @description "Tabs after the overview tab, each listing declared field names (workspace)."
        @tier "presentation"
      enter : "none" | "fade" | "rise" | "scale" | "slide"
        @label "Enter"
        @description "How this element animates in when it mounts (theme-styled); overrides the theme's default slot entry. `none` opts out."
        @tier "presentation"
      enterDelay : number
        @label "Enter Delay"
        @description "Stagger step for the entry: waits this many `--motion-enter-stagger` steps before animating."
        @tier "presentation"
      ariaLabel : string
        @label "Aria-label"
        @description "Accessible name read by screen readers when the visible text is missing or not descriptive (e.g. an icon-only control)."
        @synonyms "aria-label"
        @tier "presentation"
      ariaLabelledby : string
        @label "Aria-labelledby"
        @description "Id of the element whose text names this one."
        @synonyms "aria-labelledby"
        @tier "presentation"
      ariaDescribedby : string
        @label "Aria-describedby"
        @description "Id of the element whose text describes this one (help text, error)."
        @synonyms "aria-describedby"
        @tier "presentation"
      ariaLive : "off" | "polite" | "assertive"
        @label "Aria-live"
        @description "Announce changes to this region: polite waits for a pause, assertive interrupts."
        @synonyms "aria-live"
        @tier "presentation"
      ariaCurrent : "page" | "step" | "location" | "date" | "time" | "true" | "false"
        @label "Aria-current"
        @description "Marks the current item in a set: the current page, step, location, date or time."
        @synonyms "aria-current"
        @tier "presentation"
      ariaPressed : "true" | "false" | "mixed"
        @label "Aria-pressed"
        @description "Toggle-button state."
        @synonyms "aria-pressed"
        @tier "presentation"
      ariaExpanded : boolean
        @label "Aria-expanded"
        @description "Whether the element it controls is expanded."
        @synonyms "aria-expanded"
        @tier "presentation"
      ariaSelected : boolean
        @label "Aria-selected"
        @description "Whether this item is selected (tabs, options, grid cells)."
        @synonyms "aria-selected"
        @tier "presentation"
      ariaHidden : boolean
        @label "Aria-hidden"
        @description "Hide from assistive technology (decorative content only)."
        @synonyms "aria-hidden"
        @tier "presentation"
      ariaBusy : boolean
        @label "Aria-busy"
        @description "This region is updating; assistive technology waits before announcing it."
        @synonyms "aria-busy"
        @tier "presentation"
      role : "alert" | "alertdialog" | "application" | "article" | "banner" | "blockquote" | "button" | "caption" | "cell" | "checkbox" | "code" | "columnheader" | "combobox" | "complementary" | "contentinfo" | "definition" | "deletion" | "dialog" | "document" | "emphasis" | "feed" | "figure" | "form" | "generic" | "grid" | "gridcell" | "group" | "heading" | "img" | "insertion" | "link" | "list" | "listbox" | "listitem" | "log" | "main" | "marquee" | "math" | "menu" | "menubar" | "menuitem" | "menuitemcheckbox" | "menuitemradio" | "meter" | "navigation" | "none" | "note" | "option" | "paragraph" | "presentation" | "progressbar" | "radio" | "radiogroup" | "region" | "row" | "rowgroup" | "rowheader" | "scrollbar" | "search" | "searchbox" | "separator" | "slider" | "spinbutton" | "status" | "strong" | "subscript" | "superscript" | "switch" | "tab" | "table" | "tablist" | "tabpanel" | "term" | "textbox" | "time" | "timer" | "toolbar" | "tooltip" | "tree" | "treegrid" | "treeitem"
        @label "Role"
        @description "WAI-ARIA role when the element's native semantics don't describe it."
        @tier "presentation"
      lang : string
        @label "Lang"
        @description "Language of this element's content (BCP 47, e.g. ar, sl, en)."
        @tier "presentation"
      dir : "ltr" | "rtl" | "auto"
        @label "Dir"
        @description "Text direction of this element's content."
        @tier "presentation"
      tabIndex : number
        @label "Tab Index"
        @description "0 puts the element in the Tab order; -1 makes it focusable only programmatically."
        @tier "presentation"
      viewerRole : string = ""
        @label "Viewer's role"
        @description "The viewer's role that each action's `roles` is checked against; bind it at the call site (e.g. `viewerRole: @user.role`). Empty = only actions with no `roles` show."
        @tier "policy"
      selfFetch : boolean = true
        @label "Fetch its own row on mount?"
        @description "true (default) = a mount that carries an id loads that one row (never the collection); a create-mode mount skips the load. false = a composing atom owns the load."
        @tier "internal"
    }
  }

  page "/detail-panel" as DetailPanelPage -> DetailPanelRender
}
